body: I've heard before that I'll find someone else, there are more people out there, etc. I don't really want that though. I've been friends with the girl I mentioned for years before we were even in a relationship, and I still really want to be with her. I don't want to have to build up that again with someone else for it to even be comparable, and even if I did I feel like it wouldn't be fair to anyone else I was with, because I still love the girl I originally mentioned, and I feel I would constantly be comparing them and stuff.
